Learner with headset practicing speaking test module

pages.description: Learner Progress Overview with PTE Score Target Gauge (10-90 scale), skill breakdowns (Speaking, Writing, Reading, Listening), skill projection line chart, weak area diagnostic alerts, and quick launch practice section.
Categorized PTE task type explorer (22 official question types grouped under Speaking, Writing, Reading, Listening) with difficulty filters, completion status, and quick practice launch buttons.

Interactive PTE exam simulator with prompt viewer, real-time timer countdown, audio recorder waveform/mic controls (Speaking), rich text box with word counter & spell check (Writing), drag-and-drop / select menus (Reading), and audio playback engine (Listening).

AI Evaluation report page presenting PTE Overall Score (10-90), sub-skill radar chart (Oral Fluency, Pronunciation, Grammar, Vocabulary, Discourse), annotated error feedback, AI suggestions, and model high-score responses.
Filterable history table logging all completed practice sessions, previous score trends, audio recording playback replay, and review links.

shared_components.description: Header navigation with logo, active section links, PTE goal badge (e.g. Target 79+), streak counter badge, and theme toggle.
Circular / Arc PTE score indicator (10-90) with target reference marker and sub-score indicators.
Simulated live audio input visualizer with mic sensitivity status, recording timer, stop/submit buttons, and playback wave.
Focused text area editor displaying real-time word count, paragraph counter, recommended length gauge, and backspace restriction info toggle.
Interactive radar visualization using Recharts for enabling skills (Fluency, Pronunciation, Grammar, Vocabulary, Spelling).

key_user_flows.task_execution: Dashboard or TaskSelection -> Select Task (e.g., 'Describe Image' or 'Write Essay') -> Exam Practice Workspace -> Mic Record / Type Answer -> Click Submit Answer -> Simulated AI Evaluation Processing -> Comprehensive Score & Feedback View -> Save to Task History
key_user_flows.progress_tracking: Dashboard -> View Target vs Current Score -> Inspect Weak Skill Breakdown -> Click 'Practice Weakest Task' -> Direct entry into tailored practice

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select items, tab triggers, score cards, playback controls, navigation items) MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='submit-essay-button', data-testid='task-card-describe-image', data-testid='pte-overall-score-gauge').
testing_and_accessibility.wcag_standards: Text contrast ratio > 4.5:1, readable focus rings, keyboard accessible task selection, non-transparent overlay dropdowns.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete PTE Preparation SaaS application using .js file components.
Implement realistic demo AI scoring engine for Speaking, Writing, Reading, and Listening so users can practice without external API keys.
Ensure the calm slate-teal palette (#0F172A, #0284C7, #0D9488) creates a high-focus exam environment.
Ensure every page and component includes proper data-testid attributes as specified.
Use Shadcn UI components where available and keep spacing generous (p-6, p-8).
